breakAttempts: Checked the merged wait predicate against every session route main's outbox publishes for a comment.created (outbox/publisher.go publishDestinations:660-687): the issue route (route.route), the session claimant (publishClaimantRoute; readCommentRoutes' claimed_by session), the primary document's session authors on an issue with no route and no session claimant (publishPrimaryDocumentAuthors; readCommentRoutes' primary doc created_by or version authors), the reply thread's sessions (publishAuthorRoutes reply_to; input.ReplyTo), a new comment's document authors (commentedDocument; input.Anchor / owner.ArtifactID), the ask's followers (publishFollowerRoutes; ask_followers), and the previous claimant (publishPreviousClaimant: issue.claimed / issue.released only, not a comment). Every route is covered.

Residual, not a failure: readCommentRoutes reads the claimant and followers before the transaction opens and the outbox reads them at publish time, so a claim or ask follow made between the comment's pre-commit read and its publish, while the listener is mid take-over, can still give that session two copies; the window is the comment request itself.
